About the app

What is Teen Patti Pro?

Teen Patti Pro is an Android card and casino game app built around India’s favourite three-card game, Teen Patti (also called 3 Patti or Flash). Alongside the classic table, the app’s lobby includes Dragon vs Tiger, Andar Bahar, 7 Up Down, Car Roulette, Horse Racing, Wingo Lottery, Chicken Road and slot games such as Fortune Gems and Explorer Slots.

Everything runs from a single account and wallet, so you can switch from a Teen Patti table to a quick Dragon vs Tiger round without logging in again. Live tables show round history and trends, and daily features like the 7-day check-in, VIP gifts and Refer & Earn reward regular players.

Because Teen Patti Pro is distributed as an APK file, you install it directly from this official page instead of an app store. The steps below walk you through it safely.

Quick rules

Teen Patti hand rankings (highest to lowest)

Every Teen Patti table in the app uses these standard rankings. Odds are for a random 3-card hand from a 52-card deck (22,100 possible hands).

#HandWhat it meansExampleCombinationsProbability
1Trail / SetThree cards of the same rankA♠ A♥ A♦520.24%
2Pure SequenceThree consecutive cards of the same suitQ♥ K♥ A♥480.22%
3Sequence (Run)Three consecutive cards, mixed suits4♣ 5♦ 6♠7203.26%
4Color (Flush)Three cards of the same suit, not in sequence2♦ 8♦ J♦1,0964.96%
5PairTwo cards of the same rankK♣ K♦ 7♠3,74416.94%
6High CardNone of the above — highest card winsA♠ 9♥ 4♣16,44074.39%

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is Teen Patti Pro?

Teen Patti Pro is an Android game app that brings the classic Indian three-card game Teen Patti together with Dragon vs Tiger, Andar Bahar, 7 Up Down, Fortune Gems slots, Car Roulette, Horse Racing and other quick games in one lobby.

How do I download the Teen Patti Pro APK?

Tap the Download APK button on this page, open the downloaded teen-patti-pro.apk file, allow installs from your browser when Android asks, then tap Install. The full steps are in the How to Install section above.

Is Teen Patti Pro available on the Google Play Store?

Teen Patti Pro is distributed as an APK file for Android, which is why you install it directly from this website instead of from the Play Store. Always download the APK from the official site to make sure you get the genuine, latest version.

Is the Teen Patti Pro APK safe to install?

Download only from the official link on this page, keep Google Play Protect switched on, and scan the file if you like before installing. Never install modified (mod) or 'hacked' versions from other sites: they can contain malware and put your account at risk.

Can I play Teen Patti Pro on an iPhone or PC?

The app is built for Android phones and tablets. iPhone (iOS) is not supported. On a Windows PC you can run the APK using an Android emulator such as BlueStacks or LDPlayer.

Who can play Teen Patti Pro?

Only adults aged 18 or older may use the app, and only where online games of this kind are legal. Laws differ between countries and Indian states, and some prohibit online money games entirely, so check your local rules before you download or play.

How do I update Teen Patti Pro to the latest version?

Return to this page and download the latest APK, then install it over your current version. Your account stays linked to your login, so you do not lose your progress.

What are the Teen Patti hand rankings?

From highest to lowest: Trail (three of a kind), Pure Sequence (straight flush), Sequence (straight), Color (flush), Pair, and High Card. A-K-Q is the highest sequence and A-2-3 is the second highest.
